description: German valve manufacturer whose private-equity ownership is stated only on the About page.

criteria.target_business: Manufacturer of industrial valves or other flow-control equipment
criteria.exclusions: pure distributors or resellers; companies owned by private equity firms

html: Ferrum Valves manufactures cast iron gate valves and check valves for municipal water networks.
Our foundry and assembly plant are located in Leipzig, Germany.
Founded in 1952, Ferrum Valves has been part of the portfolio of Granite Peak Capital, a private equity firm, since 2021.

label_rationale: Industry, target business and geography are met (manufacturer with a plant in Leipzig, Germany), but the About page states ownership by a private equity firm, so the exclusion applies. Finding it requires fetching the About page.
